work.text: They lack the fire of G. B. Piranesi's early work … but if not by his hand, they are so immediately inspired by him, that they must either be reproductions of lost drawings, or the work of Francesco Piranesi … But on the whole I think their style fits in with one's estimate of the development of G. B. Piranesi's work.

moment.text: In 1776, he created his best known work as a 'restorer' of ancient sculpture, the Piranesi Vase, and in 1777–78 he published Avanzi degli Edifici di Pesto (Remains of the Edifices of Paestum).

among his more attentive scholars being Robert Adam, Chambers, Dance, and many other architects of the late eighteenth century, and through these he influenced the decorative designers from Chippendale to Pergolesi.

matters.text: It was Piranesi's custom to shut himself up in his own room and to work straight … on, without intermission, if an idea had struck him, or if he had a subject in hand : he had no patience. Engrossed in his labours, he could not endure to lay down his tools to take food or rest.
He died in Rome in 1778 after a long illness, and was buried in the church he had helped restore, Santa Maria del Priorato.
